title: Limits of local curvature for constructing search subspaces in segmentation models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25822v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We examine how well subspaces constructed from local curvature represent the change in the gradient update field after a finite step in semantic segmentation models. The local response is the action of the curvature operator on the actual input displacement. In a study of 50 images and two models, we measure the ratio of the loss increase attained in a fixed subspace to that attained in the full space. This ratio decreases as the search radius increases. On ten images from the same sample, we compare the one-dimensional subspace spanned by the initial gradient with two rank-16 subspaces for both models. The two equal-rank subspaces are assessed at the same initial states, using the same actual steps and measured vectors. Adding generalised Gauss-Newton directions to the initial gradient reduces the mean relative error in representing the field change from 0.922 to 0.874 for the first model and from 0.819 to 0.763 for the second. translated_title: 分割模型中构建搜索子空间的局部曲率极限
translated_abstract: 我们检验了由局部曲率构造的子空间在语义分割模型中对有限步长后梯度更新场变化的表征能力。局部响应是曲率算子对实际输入位移的作用。在针对50张图像和两个模型的研究中，我们测量了在固定子空间中获得的损失增量与在全空间中获得的损失增量之比。该比值随搜索半径的增大而减小。在来自同一样本的十张图像上，我们针对两个模型比较了由初始梯度张成的一维子空间与两个秩为16的子空间。这两个等秩子空间在相同的初始状态下、使用相同的实际步长和测得的向量进行评估。在初始梯度基础上加入广义高斯-牛顿方向，可将表征场变化的平均相对误差从第一个模型的0.922降至0.874，从第二个模型的0.819降至0.763。
tldr: 该研究发现基于局部曲率构造的搜索子空间表征梯度更新场变化的能力随搜索半径增大而衰减，但在初始梯度中加入广义高斯-牛顿方向可显著降低语义分割模型中的表征相对误差。
en_tdlr: This study shows that search subspaces constructed from local curvature degrade in representing gradient update field changes as the search radius grows, while adding generalized Gauss-Newton directions to the initial gradient significantly reduces the mean relative error in semantic segmentation models.
